description.content: Weather forecasts based on PWS location

Returns a 5-day daily weather forecast for a location specified by geocode (latitude and longitude). Typically used in conjunction with PWS station coordinates obtained from the observations endpoint.

query.description: (Required) Latitude and longitude as a comma-separated pair (e.g., 37.774,-122.419)
Response format. Only JSON is currently supported.
Unit system for measurement values. e = Imperial (English), m = Metric, s = SI (metric with Pa pressure), h = Hybrid (UK)
Language code for forecast text (e.g., en-US, fr-FR)

description.content: REST API for Personal Weather Station (PWS) data provided by Weather Underground (hosted at api.weather.com). Provides current conditions, daily summaries, hourly and daily historical records, 5-day forecasts, and station location lookup. Access requires a free API key issued to registered PWS contributors.
